final_vs_pre_guardrail_check.semantics: guarded = non-CAHPS, non-improvement, non-new (new 2023: C12 CBP; D07 MPF treated as new through 2024 per the 2025 Tech Notes change note, and empirically exempt here). cap5_consistent tests final == clip(pre, base2022 +/- 5) at display precision (percent and 0-100 numeric measures). Restricted-range measures (complaints C23/D02) in restricted_range_test.

findings.published_base_model: clip vs the PUBLISHED 2022 cut points reproduces every boundary on 26 of 32 cap-tested guarded splits (35 guarded splits total; the 3 restricted-range complaints splits are tested in restricted_range_test, where all 3 are falsified). The consistent splits include clip-bound boundaries on 7 splits (C06/ALL on 1, C07/ALL on 2, C08/ALL on 4, C24/ALL on 1, C26/ALL on 3, D01/MA-PD on 2, D03/MA-PD on 1). It is FALSIFIED on 9 splits (C01/ALL, C02/ALL, C10/ALL, C23/ALL, C28/ALL, D02/MA-PD, D02/PDP, D09/MA-PD, D11/MA-PD): 11 boundaries, 9 of them at the 1|2-star boundary. 2 cells (C10/ALL 1|2-star: pre 86 base 82 final 80; C28/ALL 2|3-star: pre 77 base 61 final 59) are inconsistent with ANY clip against the published base (final strictly on the far side of the base from pre).
findings.one_sidedness: every falsifying cell is MORE GENEROUS than the published-base model (lower boundary where higher is better, higher where lower is better), concentrated at the lowest star boundaries (star_label_census in tallies).
findings.inference: consistent with an UNPUBLISHED recomputed 2022 base (the rerun convention the 2024 Tech Notes later made explicit and published as K-7/K-8; 2023 published no basis table). Status: inference, not documented. Supporting evidence: a replay of the PUBLISHED 2022 scores (1 realization, ward_tie, all-numeric membership) lands exactly on the implied base for C01 (38) and within 1 for D09/MA-PD (72 vs implied 73), but far from it for C10/D11; the mechanism is not determined.

tallies.counting_rule:
Counting rule for the guardrail-basis findings.

    guarded rows = status startswith 'guarded'. Of these, cap-tested rows
    carry all_cap5_consistent (non-restricted, 2022 base present);
    restricted-range rows (complaints) are tested in rr_test instead.
    A cap-tested split is falsified when any boundary has
    cap5_consistent == False. A restricted split is falsified on a boundary
    when the published final mismatches the clip expectation under BOTH
    range variants (prior-year and current-year published scores).

restricted_range_test.semantics: cap = five percent of the score range; variants prior-year vs current-year published scores, org-split. RESULT: with the published base (1.14) and either variant's cap the clip lands at 1.27-1.28 on the MA-side complaints splits, far from both published finals (1.53 published in the data tables / 1.52 in the final Tech Notes) - the complaints splits are part of the falsified-published-base set; the operative base and range inputs are unpublished. All boundaries not listed in tallies.restricted_falsified_cells match pre exactly.

anomalies: C23 and D02(MA-PD) 1-2 star FINAL cut points: the first-release Tech Notes (09/28/2022) and the published data tables (Oct 04 2022, the only vintage ever posted) read 1.53; the final Tech Notes (01/19/2023) read 1.52. The published data tables carry 1.53.

The final version's Document Change Log entry reads (normalized): '9/28/2022 Fixed a typo in the 1- and 2- star cut points for measure C24 and D02 (MAPD cut points only) and fixed a typo in the 1/19/2023 description of the restricted range cap under Methodology for Assigning Stars to the Part C and Part D Measures'. In the release diff record (runs/tn2023_release_diff.json, catalog item c23_d02_1_2_star_cutpoint_cells), the cut-point cells that change numerically between releases are C23's and D02(MA-PD)'s; C24's cut-point cells are identical after whitespace normalization.

Impact check [exact]: no MA-side contract has a published C23/D02 score in (1.52, 1.53] (nearest is 1.50 -> 2 stars under both readings), so the 1.52-vs-1.53 discrepancy flips no published measure star in the 2023 data tables.

The first release defines the restricted-range cap on the CURRENT year's score range (Methodology body + Attachment J); the 01/19/2023 version reads PRIOR year's in both passages (release-diff catalog item restricted_range_cap_redefinition, located on both passages).

First-release Table J-3 5-star cells for C23 and C24 read '>= 0.19' and '>= 7 %'; the final version reads '<= 0.19' and '<= 7 %' (both measures are lower-is-better per their General Trend fields; release-diff catalog item j3_direction_symbol_cells).
2023 Cut Point Trend document (10/31/2022) D12/PDP 2023 4-star cell reads '>= 84 % to < 84 %' - an empty interval as printed; both Tech Notes versions and the data table read '< 86 %'.

Table 4: Minimum Number of Measure Scores Required for an Improvement Measure Rating by Contract Type, Part D row: 4 columns read '6 of 11' in the first release and '5 of 11' in the final version (one the starred variant; release-diff catalog item table4_part_d_row). The Document Change Log entry does not describe this change.
